poker-drop.goal: Make poker hands in any line before the well fills up.
poker-drop.how-to-play.step-1: Tap a column to drop the next card into it.
poker-drop.how-to-play.step-2: Five cards in a line, across, up or diagonal, make a poker hand.
poker-drop.how-to-play.step-3: Two pair or better bursts: the cards that make the hand pop.
poker-drop.how-to-play.step-4: Cards above fall down and can make a new hand.
poker-drop.name: Poker Drop
poker-drop.tagline: Drop cards. Make hands. Watch them burst.
poker-drop.tutorial.step-1: Tap the gap to drop your card there.
poker-drop.tutorial.step-2: Two pair! The cards that make the hand burst.
poker-drop.tutorial.step-3: The cards above fell and made another hand: a cascade!
poker-drop.tutorial.step-4: Make the hands the level asks for before the well fills up.
